adverse_hypothesis: Completed stages were silently re-executed or their verdicts changed
evidence: Git history and unchanged DS-00 through DS-05 authority files
resolution: Reuse-only baseline retained and no previous-stage correction was required

adverse_hypothesis: A second current design-standard authority was created
evidence: README authority declaration and stage directories
resolution: README remains the single current integration entry and stage files remain subordinate

adverse_hypothesis: Bibliographic digits were mistaken for adopted engineering values
evidence: Edition register evidence fields and DS-03 through DS-05 adoption/value scans
resolution: Metadata numerics are distinguished from engineering design numerics; adopted unsourced engineering numerics count is zero

adverse_hypothesis: Historical H29/H31 or allowable-stress references became current authority
evidence: Adoption statuses plus legacy exclusion prose
resolution: Legacy occurrences remain reference exclusion or historical-control context only

adverse_hypothesis: Repository solver HTTP analyzer IF3 and external Analyzer were conflated
resolution: Seven identities are separated and external relationships remain evidence-blocked

adverse_hypothesis: Manual workflow statements were promoted to observed physical I/O
resolution: Manual evidence is reference-only and no machine-observed claim is adopted

adverse_hypothesis: Exit zero or an existing file could publish a stale result
resolution: Success requires freshness provenance parseability and authoritative source binding

adverse_hypothesis: License failure could be normalized as successful analysis
evidence: error and license matrix negative scenarios
resolution: License state must be distinguishable and cannot publish success

adverse_hypothesis: Local/global axes DOF I/J or reaction signs were inferred
resolution: Repository conventions are labeled non-authoritative for external software and asymmetric probes are mandatory

adverse_hypothesis: Partial output locks or processes could leak across jobs
resolution: Isolation cleanup crash recovery and mixed-output rejection acceptance criteria are explicit

adverse_hypothesis: CSV PDF or mock artifacts could bypass live IF3 authority
resolution: Derived exports declare lineage and mock or stale sources cannot be authoritative

adverse_hypothesis: Apollo output alone could approve an Apollo Golden
resolution: No catalog case is approved and independent parent-oracle rules are mandatory

adverse_hypothesis: Analytical expected values could inherit implementation conventions
resolution: Two independent derivations plus signed conventions and checksums are required

adverse_hypothesis: Tolerances could be widened after observing mismatches
resolution: Absolute relative zero display internal rounding and conversion rules are separately predeclared

adverse_hypothesis: A single unversioned reference run could be called reproducible
resolution: Fixed identity checksums and three executions are required; current reproducibility counts remain zero

adverse_hypothesis: Regression Goldens could be self-approved
resolution: Proposer and approver separation plus independent parent oracle is required

adverse_hypothesis: A numeric match could imply semantic parity or vice versa
resolution: The two decisions have independent gates and neither can promote the other

adverse_hypothesis: Axis swaps or end reversals could be accepted without proof
resolution: Only predeclared invertible matrices permutations and sign maps with equilibrium checks are allowed

adverse_hypothesis: Displayed rounded values or incompatible units could produce false parity
resolution: Producer precision unit conversion and near-zero rules precede comparison

adverse_hypothesis: Missing extra duplicate empty or malformed data could be ignored
resolution: Symmetric coverage uniqueness finiteness mapping and tolerance failure rules are fail-closed

adverse_hypothesis: Manual text or repository samples could stand in for a fixed SPACER run
resolution: All 15 actual parity approvals remain blocked and reference identity is required

adverse_hypothesis: DS-06 through DS-08 blockers could be omitted from the final gate
resolution: Exact set equality covers 10 Analyzer 8 Golden and 8 parity blocker IDs

adverse_hypothesis: Document completion could be misreported as numeric readiness or prior tokens could drift
resolution: Canonical DS-07 and DS-08 tokens restored exactly; document and numeric gates remain separate

adverse_hypothesis: Quoted historical or prohibition terms could be misreported as live open items
resolution: Context-aware scan reports live fields separately and classifies intentional prose occurrences

adverse_hypothesis: A majority or waiver could override a failed numeric gate
resolution: Every release predicate is conjunctive and default-empty values fail closed
